content: This medication is intended for vaginal use only. If you are using an over-the-counter product for self-treatment, carefully read all instructions on the product packaging before use. If you have any questions, consult your pharmacist. Additionally, review the Patient Information Leaflet provided with the product. Before and after using this medication, wash your hands thoroughly. Avoid contact with your eyes. If the product accidentally gets into your eyes, rinse them immediately with plenty of water. The dosage of this medication is determined based on your medical condition and response to treatment. If you are using the vaginal cream, follow the instructions on the package to properly fill and use the applicator. Lie on your back with your knees bent toward your chest, and insert one applicator filled with cream into the vagina as far as it can comfortably go. Slowly press the plunger of the applicator to apply the cream. If you are using the vaginal tablet, you may use either the applicator or your finger to insert the tablet. Unwrap the tablet before use. Follow the package instructions to fill the applicator with the vaginal tablet. Lie on your back with your knees bent toward your chest, and insert the tablet or applicator into the vagina as far as it can comfortably go. If you experience itching or burning around the external vaginal area (vulva), apply the skin cream to the affected area, typically once or twice daily, for no more than seven days. Continue using this medication every day for the full duration prescribed, even if your symptoms improve after a few days or if your menstrual period begins. While using this medication, do not use tampons, douches, spermicides, or other vaginal products. Inform your doctor if your condition does not improve after three days or if it persists for more than seven days. Additionally, notify your doctor if your infection recurs within two months. Possible side effects include vaginal or urethral burning, itching, pain, or lower abdominal cramps. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not a complete list of potential side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar guidance. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other azole antifungal agents (such as terconazole or fluconazole), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Ask your doctor whether sexual intercourse is safe while using this product. Be aware that this medication may weaken rubber products such as latex condoms, diaphragms, or cervical caps, potentially leading to failure and resulting in pregnancy. Do not use these products during treatment with this medication. Do not use this medication for self-treatment if you are pregnant. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. If you are pregnant, follow your doctor’s instructions on how to use the applicator to insert this medication. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. To help prevent vaginal yeast infections, thoroughly dry the genital area after showering, bathing, or swimming. Avoid wearing tight jeans, nylon underwear, pantyhose, wet bathing suits, or damp/sweaty exercise clothes for extended periods. If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and use your next dose at the regular time. Store this medication at room temperature. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
